g.text: Bailey balcony — straightened layout / REVIEWED BASELINE
315 seats · PDF pages 5 and 7 · seat-based schematic · not a physical scale drawing
Left stage end → left wing → rear center → right wing → right stage end. Front of seats faces down.
Legend: white = walkable (0) · ochre = seats (s) · slate = walls / columns (w) · teal = absorbing exits
Every seat spawns directly below into its row passage. Dark cells in CCC represent columns; radial aisles connect all passages.
Review: chair counts and source labels; aisle topology; four exit positions; omitted seat; schematic widths and end-exit relocation.
Rows/columns in CSV are 1-based, origin upper left. Exact seat identifiers are available as SVG tooltips and in seats.csv.
